claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Davis, champion of the United Kingdom, for the championship of the world and £200 a side at St. George Hall; Davis was knocked senseless in the fifth round.
claims.excerpt: prize fight for the yf the world and £200 a sid

fights.excerpt: prize fight for the yf the world and £200 a sid
fights.notes: The referee declared Allen the winner after cries of foul; the item is a fuller re-run of the London dispatch, with heavy OCR damage.

notes: Fight of last Thursday (4 April); OCR damage throughout.
